candidate_003_result: Pure penalty FKN=1 passed the legacy rectangle numeric screen but failed the stricter v0.6.3 endpoint penetration gate: 0.00058725016 mm > 0.00001 mm. It is rejected for the pilot.
installed_solver_observation: For pure penalty, FTOLN did not produce the augmented-Lagrange initial stiffness. Printed rectangle stiffness was 34210/36972, not 2e8. Do not equate the same FTOLN/FKN with the same absolute stiffness across algorithms.
rationale: Observed endpoint penetration exceeds the existing gate by a factor of about 58.7. A prospectively selected 100x normal penalty factor tests the required scale while retaining fixed initial stiffness and all physical/acceptance settings. Verify force, pressure, endpoint penetration, equilibrium, warnings and repeatability before use.
